Ronaldo Franco Jaldin

Teaching

I teach machine learning and competitive programming, and help students prepare for national and international contests.

I teach in Spanish and English.

Introduction to Machine Learning I

UMSS, Cochabamba · 8 classes

2026

Neural networks, backpropagation, an MLP from scratch on MNIST, matrix calculus, gradients and Jacobians, optimization, dropout, batch normalization, cross-validation, and model selection.

Introduction to Large Language Models

Private online classes · 10 classes

2025

Transformers, pre-training, tokenization, scaling and limitations, fine-tuning with LoRA, alignment, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation.

Advanced Competitive Programming Workshop

UMSS, Cochabamba · 4 classes

2025

Graphs, data structures, dynamic programming and its optimizations, number theory, probability, geometry, strings, FFT/NTT, and generating functions.

ICPC Training Camps

UMSS, Cochabamba · July and December · 16 classes

2018–2019

Algorithm instruction, guided problem solving, contest strategy, and practice under competition conditions.

School coaching and ICPC co-coaching

Various institutions in Bolivia · More than 20 classes

2016–2023

Coaching students from introductory algorithmic thinking through preparation for national and international competitions.

Community work

I served on the Scientific Committee of the International Olympiad in Informatics in 2025, contributing to problem setting, testing, and contest design. I have also organized and set problems for the SanSi Cup Bolivia and the 2023 and 2024 individual national programming contests at UMSS. These activities involved more than 200 participants.
